Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Class EvaluationResultEntity

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.EvaluationResultEntity
@Entity public class EvaluationResultEntity extends Object
JPA entity representing a row in the evaluation_results table.

Stores a denormalized snapshot of a single prompt evaluation run, including the AI-generated section output and all five quality scores. Section and score fields are stored flat (not in separate tables) because evaluations are write-once, read-many artifacts with low cardinality.

The comparison_id column is nullable — it links this evaluation to a ComparisonResultEntity when the evaluation was run as part of a side-by-side comparison.
